title: pmx journal event v2
description: One line of runs/<run_id>/journal.jsonl: the five-field envelope plus the payload of exactly one event of the catalogue. Integers only: no float, no wall clock, no provider cost. CONTRACTS_V2 section 9. Amendment C1b (section 17) adds cash_event_applied, instrument_closed and forecast_resolved, widens the id, provider, origin, reason, price_source and phase enums, admits ticks where a binary carried bp and milli-units where it carried contracts, and declares the instrument fields of market_listed and the horizons of forecast_recorded as optional until gate G2 promotes them with decided_at_ms (rulings R148, R152, R157, R160, R164, R165). The three new events are declared under $defs and enter oneOf, and the settle phase enters the phase enum of order_placed, filled and fee_charged, in the gate G2 commit that gives pmx.journal their dataclasses and PHASES (ruling R164, the discipline of R129): pmx.journal pins oneOf and the phase enums to its classes, so a schema ahead of the classes would refuse the journals the engine wave must write.

sensorList.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 18.1): a resolved sensor set, sorted, always containing tape.

rule_proposed.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 18.2, rulings R237 and R274): a valid propose_rule of an agent. Declared here and admitted to oneOf by the first engine lot after the amendment, in the commit that gives pmx.journal its dataclass (the discipline of rulings R129 and R164).

workflow_step_executed.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 18.4, rulings R243 and R274): one step of a workflow genome, digest only; never emitted for a linear genome. Declared here and admitted to oneOf with rule_proposed.

family_registered.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 18.2, ruling R238): a pre-registered hypothesis family, written before any replicate-fold read of its rules. Declared here and admitted to oneOf by gate G4 with O2's evolution journal.

rule_tested.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 18.2, ruling R238): one test of one rule on one fold, fit, replicate, live or transfer. Declared here and admitted to oneOf with family_registered.

rule_promoted.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 18.2, rulings R238 and R239): a rule that held on the replicate fold and passed its family's FDR step enters the hive as an insight visible from fit_t1_ms + interval_ms.

rule_demoted.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 18.2, ruling R239): a promoted rule whose live record turned against it, or whose author's reputation fell; never re-promoted.

priceTicks.description: A price in the instrument's ticks (CONTRACTS_V2 17.1, ruling R148): bp on a binary, whose 1..9999 bound the loader and the runner enforce, ticks up to PRICE_TICKS_MAX otherwise.

card.description: Amendment C1 (16.5, ruling R119) and amendment C1c (18.1, 18.4, rulings R230 and R243): the three components A1 ships in lot 6; optional here until gate G4 completes the evolution fixture with them at their defaults.

sensor_catalogue_hash.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 18.1, rulings R231 and R274): the CATALOGUE_HASH the run read; optional until promoted with observation_built.sensors.

sealed_test_opened.description: open_sealed_test read the sealed fold for a named claim. It is written before any market id is returned, so an aborted claim still leaves the peek on the record (CONTRACTS_V2 section 12.7).

claim_id.description: c-<hash8>-<kind>-<provider>-h<horizon_bars>-<genome16> since amendment C1b (17.8, ruling R162); the v2 form c-<hash8>-<provider>-<genome16> still validates so a journal written before the amendment reads, and is never written again.

market_listed.description: A market's leak-free metadata, recorded once per run at the bar it is first listed. An observed input, not a derived number: without it the projection cannot rebuild the horizon buckets, the block keys or the per-category and per-fold rows from the journal alone (CONTRACTS_V2 sections 9.2 and 9.5).

kind.description: Amendment C1b (17.3, ruling R164): the eight instrument fields, required since gate G2 landed pmx.journal's dataclasses and rebuilt the backtest fixture. On a binary they carry the mapping of 17.1: binary, the provider, provider_id, 100, 1_000_000, continuous, null, null.

provider_labels.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 7.2, 7.14, rulings R265 and R274): the four taxonomy fields, optional until the first engine lot after the amendment promotes them with their dataclass fields.

market_priced.description: The prices of one open market at one bar: close_bp is the close of the bar itself (the mark_price_bp of CONTRACTS_V2 section 8.7) and last_close_bp the close of the last completed bar at the bar's open, which is the market's own forecast on that bar and first_price_bp when no bar is completed yet.

reason.description: corporate_action, roll and delisted are amendment C1b's (17.3); debit is ruling R179's: a cash-event debit took the agent's cash below zero and every resting order of the agent is expired by that event.

sensors.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 18.1, rulings R231 and R274): the resolved sensor set the observation was narrowed to; optional until the first engine lot after the amendment promotes it with its dataclass field.

price_ref_ticks.description: Amendment C1b (17.5, ruling R157): the reference price in ticks on a continuous instrument with horizons; null on a binary. Required since gate G2 (ruling R164): one event shape per name, null where the kind has no value.

horizons.description: One entry per horizon of the run on a continuous instrument; null on a binary.

phase.description: execute for an agent's order; settle for an event fill of a roll or the forced flat, landed by gate G2 together with OrderPlaced.PHASES (CONTRACTS_V2 17.3, rulings R152 and R164).

decided_at_ms.description: The bar the intent was decided at, one interval before this event's bar (CONTRACTS_V2 16.2). item_index indexes that bar's action_received, so without it a rejection cannot be traced to its intent. It is optional here and becomes required in the commit that gives pmx.journal's event dataclasses the field and rebuilds the backtest fixture as a post-latency journal (ruling R129).
The bar the rejected intent was decided at (CONTRACTS_V2 16.2, ruling R129). reason is a free string, so not_tradable, ruined and no_liquidity need no enum widening here.

phase.description: execute for an agent's fill; settle for an event fill, landed by gate G2 with Filled.PHASES (rulings R152, R164).

price_source.description: CONTRACTS_V2 16.1: open, quote, limit, impact or mm. vwap is the pre-amendment spelling of the fallback base and still validates so an older journal reads, but no LiquidityModel may return it (ruling R138). event is amendment C1b's (17.3, ruling R152): an engine fill at a printed price, from liquidity.event_fill only, the one case whose phase is settle.

phase.description: execute for an agent's fill; settle for an event fill, landed by gate G2 with FeeCharged.PHASES (rulings R152, R164).

cash_cents.description: Signed since ruling R179: a debit cash event (funding, dividend, borrow_fee, carry) may leave a debit balance that the next credit repays; a fill never takes cash below zero.

positions_value_cents.description: Signed since amendment C1b (ruling R154): a short on a continuous instrument is a liability.

equity_cents.description: Signed since rulings R154 and R180: a short on a continuous instrument is a liability and equity may fall below zero while the run continues.

drawdown_bp.description: bp_ratio(equity - peak, peak), at most 0; below -10000 once equity is negative (ruling R180), so no floor.

equity_cents.description: Signed (ruling R180): ruin at a negative equity is the ordinary case on a runaway short.

cash_event_applied.description: One CashEvent of CONTRACTS_V2 17.3 applied to one agent in the settle phase (ruling R151): funding, dividend, split, roll, borrow_fee, carry or forced_flat. cash_delta_cents is the one money-moving field for funding, dividend, borrow_fee and carry (signed; a debit may take the agent's cash below zero, ruling R179) and is 0 for split, roll and forced_flat, whose money moves in the filled and fee_charged events named in order_ids. position_before and position_after are the position before the first and after the last of those event fills for roll and forced_flat, equal for funding, dividend, borrow_fee and carry, and related by split_position_milli for split (ruling R178). Declared here and admitted to oneOf at gate G2 with its pmx.journal dataclass (ruling R164).

allOf.description: A split, a roll and a forced flat move no cash here; funding, dividend, borrow_fee and carry do and place no fill.

instrument_closed.description: A continuous instrument's last bar in the run (CONTRACTS_V2 17.3, ruling R150): every position has been flattened by force_flat and the runner records what the instrument was.

forecast_resolved.description: One horizon of one continuous forecast scored at the bar its realisation became public (CONTRACTS_V2 17.5, ruling R160). The baseline directional Brier is the constant 250_000 and is not a field; the baseline pinball depends on the realisation and is.

tier.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 12.6, 18.1, rulings R235 and R254): the six fields are optional until gate G4 lands O2's dataclasses.

diet_class.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 12.5, ruling R235): 0 tape and market, 1 news, 2 hive; optional, a v2 payload reads as 0.

sensor_budget_next.description: Amendment C1c (CONTRACTS_V2 9.4, 12.6, rulings R235, R239 and R254): the five fields are optional until gate G4 lands O2's dataclasses.
